title: icon glyph gravity
explanation:
### Description

Demonstrate vtkIconGlyphFilter with various gravity settings by reading a PNG icon sheet and rendering 9 rows of icons, each with a different gravity anchor point.

**dataset → input → dataset → filter → visual_asset → renderer → infrastructure → output**

- [vtkAppendPolyData](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkAppendPolyData.html) — append poly data.
- [vtkDoubleArray](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkDoubleArray.html) — double array.
- [vtkIconGlyphFilter](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkIconGlyphFilter.html) — icon glyph filter.
- [vtkIntArray](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkIntArray.html) — int array.
- [vtkPNGReader](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkPNGReader.html) — png reader.
- [vtkPoints](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkPoints.html) — stores 3D point coordinates.
- [vtkPolyData](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkPolyData.html) — represents polygonal geometry.
- [vtkPolyDataMapper2D](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkPolyDataMapper2D.html) — poly data mapper2d.
- [vtkTexture](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkTexture.html) — applies a texture image to geometry.
- [vtkTexturedActor2D](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkTexturedActor2D.html) — textured actor2d.
- [vtkRenderWindow](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderWindow.html) — displays the rendered scene in a window on screen.
- [vtkRenderWindowInteractor](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderWindowInteractor.html) — captures mouse and keyboard events.
- [vtkRenderer](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderer.html) — assembles the scene and configures the camera.
- `Initialize()` and `Start()` launch the interactive visualization — `Initialize()` prepares the interactor and `Start()` begins the event loop.
